paite: Huan Miriam leh Aaron in Mosi in Kus numei zi a, aneih ziak in agensia ua; Kus numei bel anei ngei hi.
heading: Miriam Gawt In A-om
english: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.

paite: Amau, "Mosi kiang kia ah hia TOUPA'N thu agen tuam? Ei kiang ah leng agen sam kei a hia?" achi uh. TOUPA'N huai ana za hi.
english: They said, “Has Yahweh indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And Yahweh heard it.

paite: Mosi bel leitung a mihing tengteng sang in amigi mahmah hi.
english: Now the man Moses was very humble, above all the men who were on the surface of the earth.

paite: Thakhat in TOUPA'N Mosi, Aaron leh Miriam kiang ah, "Na thum un hong paisuk unla, kihoupihna biakbuk ah hong pai un," achi hi. Huchi in athum un ava hoh uhi.
english: Yahweh spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.

paite: TOUPA meipi dingh ah ahong paisuk a, puanin kongkhak ah ahong dingh a, Aaron leh Miriam asam a; anih un ahong paisuk uhi.
english: Yahweh came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.

paite: Ama'n, "Ka thu ngaikhia un. Na lak ua zawlnei na om uleh amah kiang ah kei TOUPA kilakna in ka kihil dia, manglam in ka houpih ding.
english: He said, “Hear now my words. If there is a prophet among you, I Yahweh will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.

paite: Ka sikha Mosi bel huchibang ahi kei. Ka inko tengteng ah amuanhuai hi.
english: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.

paite: Amah toh paukam in thuguk om lou in teltak in ka kihou ding ua; TOUPA mel leng amu ding. Huaiziak in ka sikha Mosi bangchidan a gense ngam na hi ua?" achi hi.
english: With him I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see Yahweh’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA atung uah aheh mahmah a, apai nawnta hi.
english: The anger of Yahweh was kindled against them; and he departed.

paite: Puanin tung ah meipi akikhinta hi. Ngai in, Miriam vuk bang a ngou in ahong phakta a; Aaron in Miriam a-en a, ngai in, phak ana hita maimah hi,
english: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.

paite: Huchi in Aaron in Mosi kiang ah, "Ka toupa aw, ka tung uah khelhna nga mahmah ke'n. Haihuaitak in ka na hihta ua, ka na khialta uhi.
english: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.

paite: Anu sul a pan sisa phial mahmah a ahong pawt bang in amah omsak ke'n," achi hi.
english: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in, "Pathian aw, damsak nawn dih ve," chi in TOUPA angen hi.
english: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Apa'n amai chilsiat hilhial taleh ni sagih azakta kei ding maw? Giahphual pua ah ni sagih kibu henla; huai khit chiang in pilut nawn hi hen," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”

paite: Huchi in giahphual pua ah ni sagih sung Miriam khumtuam in a-om hi. Miriam apilut nawn ma un mipite akisuan kei uhi.
english: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.

paite: Huai khit in mipite Hazeroth a pan apawt ua, Paran gamdai ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
